commit_message: Promote mesh tangents into material GPU path
pr_title: Renderer: establish color and tangent-space foundations
pr_body:
## Summary

- retain the Phase 1 renderer color-space contract
- promote imported mesh tangents and handedness into a dedicated material GPU stream
- preserve derivative TBN reconstruction as the fallback for meshes without tangents
- use one compiled material fragment stage for static and skinned meshes
- record the tangent-space and shader-sharing contract in ADR 0119

## Scope

This is renderer foundation Phase 2A. It preserves the serialized Material schema, Stable IDs, public Vertex layout, independent Outline/Shadow passes, and generic StandardLit/ToonLit/Unlit architecture. Metallic/Roughness and Occlusion texture expansion remains the next step.
